animations_enabled.label: Enable animations
animations_enabled.description: Animate busy and pending states in the popup, such as the cycling hourglass on buttons while a command runs.

battery_device.label: Battery Device
battery_device.description: The power supply device name in sysfs (e.g., BAT0 or BAT1).

poll_interval.label: Poll Interval
poll_interval.description: How often in seconds to poll battery capacity and wireless link quality.

low_battery_threshold.label: Low Battery Threshold
low_battery_threshold.description: Percentage at which the battery indicator changes to warning.

critical_battery_threshold.label: Critical Battery Threshold
critical_battery_threshold.description: Percentage at which the battery indicator turns red.

normal_color.label: Normal Color
normal_color.description: Color of the battery indicator under normal conditions.

charging_color.label: Charging Color
charging_color.description: Color of the battery indicator and lightning badge while charging.

power_saver_color.label: Power Saver Color
power_saver_color.description: Color of the battery arc when Battery Saver / Low Power Mode is active.

critical_color.label: Critical Color
critical_color.description: Color of the battery arc when battery is critically low.

icon_size.label: Icon Size
icon_size.description: Size in pixels of the circular duo indicator in the bar.

show_label.label: Show Percentage Label
show_label.description: Show the battery percentage text beside the circular indicator.
